subject.title: security(audit): warn on plugin load paths and SecretRef env fallback

question: After the default no-exec boundary is restored, should OpenClaw adopt the proposed plugin load-path and SecretRef fallback check IDs, severities, scope, and remediation?
rationale: The execution defect is mechanically resolvable, but the resulting warnings influence operator trust and credential-remediation decisions and therefore require security-owner intent.

options.title: Repair then approve
options.body: Restore explicit exec gating, add entry-point regression tests, and approve the warning contract after security-area review.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Land independently safe plugin load-path diagnostics and redesign SecretRef fallback detection in separate work.

recommendation.title: Repair then approve
recommendation.body: Restore explicit exec gating, add entry-point regression tests, and approve the warning contract after security-area review.
